name: Abstract Wall Pattern
instruction: Visualize a large wall adorned with an abstract pattern. The pattern features interlocking geometric shapes in various sizes. Some shapes are filled, while others are outlined. The overall design should create a sense of depth and movement.

Shape accuracy: The wall is large and spans a significant area.
The pattern consists of interlocking geometric shapes.
The geometric shapes vary in size, creating visual interest.
Some shapes are filled, while others are merely outlined.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The proportion of filled to outlined shapes is balanced to maintain visual harmony.
The sizes of the shapes are proportionate to each other, enhancing the abstract design.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The arrangement of shapes creates a sense of depth.
The overlapping of shapes suggests movement across the wall.
The interlocking nature of the shapes enhances the three-dimensional effect.
Object distance and contact: There is a clear distinction between filled and outlined shapes.
The shapes are positioned closely enough to create interlocking effects without overcrowding.

Instruction execution accuracy: The design accurately reflects the abstract pattern as described.
All specified attributes, such as interlocking shapes and varying sizes, are represented.
